newsitem.title: UK: UK shares gain after Wall Street recovery.
newsitem.headline: UK shares gain after Wall Street recovery.

text.p: UK stocks opened higher on Monday, taking their lead from a recovery on Wall Street on Friday where the Dow set its fourth record close of the year so far, and with firm gilts also lending support.
The FTSE 100 index was up 26.2 points at 4,082.8 by 0838 GMT, with gainers in a near 20-to-one majority. Insurance and banking stocks helped lead the initial advance.

Dealers also noted a sharp recovery in Tokyo, where the ailing Nikkei rose 4.7 percent, and said fears of an imminent rise in UK interest rates had waned after signs that consumer spending has been less robust than expected over Christmas.
